en.headline: 353 own commits, 9 PRs and 60 issues across 18 repos in 30 days
en.teaser: Most of the window went into five OpenCode skills and a profile dashboard, with upstream issue reports filed against OpenChamber and opencode.
en.overview:
The 30-day window from 2026-09-23 to 2026-10-22 has no missing days. Totals are 353 own commits, 9 pull requests and 60 issues, with no reviews recorded. A further **418 automated commits** were counted separately and are not part of the 353.

### Skill and tooling repositories

Most of the work targeted the user's own OpenCode skills. In `sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` the 7-table inventory logic was left alone while release engineering was tightened: new state markers including the broken-asset marker in seven locales, security guards for MCP probing, a registry-first host-command scan, a release-prep script and a docs-parity gate, shipped across v1.12.0 through v1.15.0. `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` started from a first SKILL.md plus reference documents and grew into three cooperating skills (core research, spreadsheet analysis, and a third capability), with validators, a thin `meld.py` CLI, handling rules for blocked sources, bilingual documentation and a GitHub Pages landing page, released as v0.1.0 to v0.4.0.

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` reached v1.0.0 and then v1.4.0, adding an offline price seed, a discovery script with chain-safety checks, a snapshot summarizer, proxy-aware helpers and a three-part output format. `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` implemented the `skill_management` plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions that write a single permission rule instead of touching skill files, published first as release candidates and then as v0.2.0. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` was a new repository collecting AGENTS.md conventions and an archived knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication, Windows path issues and remote branch handling.

### Profile dashboard and smaller repos

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` carried the largest share of commits, mostly automated: the profile README gained a 30-day activity card with a rolling workflow, an English copy pass, a peak/average summary replacing a chart, and fixes so statistics and splits stay consistent; the daily-report workflow now supports manual date input. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` was initialised as an MV3 extension and then narrowed to page translation only, with state resets, smoke tests and JSDoc type checking. `sogeisetsu/myBlog` received OpenChamber screenshot samples.

### Upstream reports

Outside own repositories the activity was issue reporting and discussion. The bulk of the 60 issues landed in `openchamber/openchamber` and `anomalyco/opencode`, covering context-panel math, capture resolution, model switching, auto-update manifests, MiMo vision handling and the TinyFish websearch provider. Four pull requests were opened and merged in `antongulin/opencode-skill-creator`, and one listing pull request was opened in `VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills`. Nine discussions were started or joined in OpenChamber's Ideas and Extensions categories.

highlights.text: Registry-first host-command scan released as v1.15.0.
v0.3.0 split the single research skill into three cooperating skills with a stricter delivery gate.
First stable release of the plan-aware model picker.
v0.2.0 shipped list, inspect, disable and enable without editing skill files.
Harden eval robustness in parsing, aggregation and install.
Context panel breakdown bar divides whole-session estimates by the last message's input.
Go endpoint rejects images that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise as supported.
Idea to store relay identity keys encrypted at rest and keep them out of settings.json backups.

zh.headline: 30 天内 353 次本人提交、9 个 PR、60 个 issue，覆盖 18 个仓库
zh.teaser: 窗口内主要精力放在五个 OpenCode skill 和个人主页看板上，同时在 OpenChamber 和 opencode 上游提交了大量 issue 报告。
zh.overview:
2026-09-23 至 2026-10-22 的 30 天窗口没有缺失数据。总计为 353 次本人提交、9 个 pull request、60 个 issue，评审数为 0。另有 **418 次自动提交**单列统计，不计入上述 353 次之中。

### skill 与工具仓库

主要工作集中在自有的 OpenCode skill 上。`sogeisetsu/asset-inventory` 保持 7 表结构与盘点逻辑不变，重点打磨发布流程：新增包括「损坏资产」在内的状态标记并覆盖七种语言、为 MCP 探测增加安全护栏、把宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先、加入发布准备脚本与文档一致性门禁，随 v1.12.0 至 v1.15.0 发布。`sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 从一份 SKILL.md 与参考文档起步，发展为三个协作 skill（核心研究、表格数据分析与第三项能力），配套校验脚本、精简的 `meld.py` 命令行入口、无法打开来源的处理规则、双语文档和 GitHub Pages 落地页，版本从 v0.1.0 走到 v0.4.0。

`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 先发布 v1.0.0，再更新到 v1.4.0，期间加入离线价格种子、带回退链检查的 agent 发现脚本、快照摘要工具、支持代理的公共辅助函数以及三段式输出格式。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 实现了 `skill_management` 插件，提供 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，通过写入单条权限规则实现禁用而不改动 skill 文件，先发候选版本再发布 v0.2.0。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 是新仓库，沉淀 AGENTS.md 约定和一份知识库，内容涉及 OpenCode V2 分发、认证、Windows 路径坑与远程分支处理。

### 主页看板与小型仓库

`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 承担了最多提交且以自动提交为主：个人主页 README 加入 30 天活动卡片和滚动更新 workflow，文案统一为英文，用峰值/均值摘要替换图表，并修复统计与拆分对不上的问题；日报 workflow 支持手动指定日期。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 以 MV3 扩展起步，随后收敛为只做整页翻译，并补充运行间状态重置、冒烟测试与 JSDoc 类型检查。`sogeisetsu/myBlog` 只加入了 OpenChamber 截图样例。

### 上游报告

自有仓库以外的工作基本是问题反馈与讨论。60 个 issue 多数提交到 `openchamber/openchamber` 与 `anomalyco/opencode`，涉及上下文面板比例计算、截图分辨率、模型切换、自动更新清单、MiMo 视觉处理以及 TinyFish 搜索服务。`antongulin/opencode-skill-creator` 有四个 pull request 被提出并合并，`VoltAgent/awesome-agent-skills` 有一个收录 PR 被提出。OpenChamber 的 Ideas 与 Extensions 分类下共发起或参与了九个讨论。

highlights.text: v1.15.0 将宿主命令扫描改为注册表优先。
v0.3.0 把单一研究 skill 拆成三个协作 skill，并收紧交付门禁。
按套餐分配模型的 picker 发布首个稳定版 v1.0.0。
v0.2.0 提供 list、inspect、disable、enable，且不改动 skill 文件。
加固解析、聚合与安装环节的评测健壮性。
上下文面板比例条用最后一条消息的输入量去除整段会话估算。
Go 端点拒绝 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声称支持的图片输入。
提议将中继身份密钥加密存储，并排除在 settings.json 备份之外。
